sketches.mechanism: Rust moves non-Copy values into functions, and the compiler rejects any later use of the moved value.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given away cannot be given again.

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation permits a self-referential infinite list because only the demanded portion is evaluated.
sketches.resonance: Endlessness becomes bearable when the present asks for only one piece of it.
sketches.draft:
forever = 1 : forever
now = head forever
main = print now

sketches.mechanism: A false _Static_assert is checked during translation and prevents the program from becoming executable.
sketches.resonance: It speaks by refusing the future in which it would have to run.
sketches.draft:
_Static_assert(0, "I refuse to become executable");
int main(void) { return 0; }
